title: Measure the selected paired computer’s HTTPS connection to ReMCP, independently of browser speed.
changes: Run a fixed-destination, authenticated network probe from the paired agent; return device download/upload Mbps, HTTP latency and jitter, and its public IP without shell commands or arbitrary URLs.
Bound probe traffic to 12 MiB down and 4 MiB up with per-device, per-peer, fleet-wide shared limits, local concurrency caps, and strict request validation.
Preserve the separate browser speed test, add device-version gating and accessible responsive diagnostics in System Monitor.
Include the imported network probe module in the public agent package, verify npm projection completeness, and retain exact-SHA security/PostgreSQL release gates.
